buildCommand:
export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off
build_date="$(date -u -d "@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
out=/src/bin/nvkr-aicr
mkdir -p "$out"
timeout --kill-after=10s 900s go build -mod=vendor -trimpath -buildvcs=false \
  -ldflags "-s -w -buildid= -X github.com/NVIDIA/aicr/pkg/cli.version=$BUILD_VERSION -X github.com/NVIDIA/aicr/pkg/cli.commit=$GIT_VERSION -X github.com/NVIDIA/aicr/pkg/cli.date=$build_date" \
  -o "$out/aicr" ./cmd/aicr
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$out/aicr" recipe \
  --service "$1" --accelerator "$2" \
  --os ubuntu --intent training --output "$out/recipe.yaml"
# OCI output requires an Argo CD repoURL; this literal never resolves, so consumers set their own.
repo=()
[ "$3" != argocd ] || repo=(--repo oci://registry.invalid/aicr-bundle)
# Layout output stages in the working directory; the source tree is read-only.
(
  cd "$out"
  timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$out/aicr" bundle \
    --recipe "$out/recipe.yaml" --deployer "$3" "${repo[@]}" \
    --output "oci-layout:$out/layout"
)
# Publish AICR's own layer bytes: one manifest holding the config and exactly one layer.
digests() { grep -o '"digest":"sha256:[0-9a-f]\{64\}"' "$1" | cut -d: -f3 | tr -d '"'; }
mapfile -t manifest < <(digests "$out/layout/index.json")
[ "${#manifest[@]}" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'AICR layout must index one manifest' >&2; exit 1; }
mapfile -t blobs < <(digests "$out/layout/blobs/sha256/${manifest[0]}")
[ "${#blobs[@]}" -eq 2 ] || { echo 'AICR manifest must reference one config and one layer' >&2; exit 1; }
layer="$out/layout/blobs/sha256/${blobs[1]}"
printf '%s  %s\n' "${blobs[1]}" "$layer" | sha256sum --quiet -c -
mkdir "$out/verify"
tar -xzf "$layer" -C "$out/verify"
root="$out/verify"
[ "$3" != argocd-helm ] || root="$root/aicr-bundle"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$out/aicr" verify "$root"
cp "$layer" "$out/bundle.tar.gz"

  --service "$1" --accelerator "$2" --platform "$3" \
  --os ubuntu --intent training --output "$out/recipe.yaml"
# Exact-leaf admission: the most specific applied overlay must be this coordinate's own
# leaf, whatever a later AICR pin resolves. The recipe's only appliedOverlays list must be
# a direct child of top-level metadata, and any list line other than a plain item
# rejects the whole list.
leaf="$2-$1-ubuntu-training-$3"
applied="$(awk '
  /^[^[:space:]#]/ { meta = 0 }
  /^metadata:[[:space:]]*$/ { meta = 1; child = -1; next }
  meta && child < 0 && /^[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]#]/ { match($0, /^[[:space:]]+/); child = RLENGTH }
  /^[[:space:]]*appliedOverlays:[[:space:]]*$/ {
    lists++; match($0, /^[[:space:]]*/); inlist = meta && RLENGTH == child; scoped += inlist; next
  }
  inlist && /^[[:space:]]*- [^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]*$/ { last = $2; next }
  inlist && (/^[[:space:]]*-/ || /^[[:space:]]*#/ || /^[[:space:]]*$/) { bad = 1 }
  { inlist = 0 }
  END { if (lists == 1 && scoped == 1 && !bad) print last }
' "$out/recipe.yaml")"
[ "$applied" = "$leaf" ] || { echo "AICR recipe must end in leaf $leaf, got '$applied'" >&2; exit 1; }
# AICR's NVKE guide gates network-operator readiness before the IB pools; Flux cannot.
hooks=()
case "$4" in helm | argocd-helm) hooks=(--readiness-hooks) ;; esac
# NVKE's GPU Operator installs the driver, so the bundle opts in to AICR's DRA eviction:
# Driver Manager deschedules the DRA kubelet plugin before a driver restart.
# Layout output stages in the working directory; the source tree is read-only.
(
  cd "$out"
  timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$out/aicr" bundle \
    --recipe "$out/recipe.yaml" --deployer "$4" "${hooks[@]}" \
    --dra-eviction-node-label nvidia.com/dra-kubelet-plugin=true \
    --output "oci-layout:$out/layout"
)
# Publish AICR's own layer bytes: one manifest holding the config and exactly one layer.
digests() { grep -o '"digest":"sha256:[0-9a-f]\{64\}"' "$1" | cut -d: -f3 | tr -d '"'; }
mapfile -t manifest < <(digests "$out/layout/index.json")
[ "${#manifest[@]}" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'AICR layout must index one manifest' >&2; exit 1; }
mapfile -t blobs < <(digests "$out/layout/blobs/sha256/${manifest[0]}")
[ "${#blobs[@]}" -eq 2 ] || { echo 'AICR manifest must reference one config and one layer' >&2; exit 1; }
layer="$out/layout/blobs/sha256/${blobs[1]}"
printf '%s  %s\n' "${blobs[1]}" "$layer" | sha256sum --quiet -c -
mkdir "$out/verify"
tar -xzf "$layer" -C "$out/verify"
root="$out/verify"
[ "$4" != argocd-helm ] || root="$root/aicr-bundle"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$out/aicr" verify "$root"
cp "$layer" "$out/bundle.tar.gz"

test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum

vendorCommand:
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64; digest=c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64; digest=564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
mkdir -p .nvkr-tools
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" .nvkr-tools/helm
export HELM_REPOSITORY_CONFIG=/tmp/nktp-repositories.yaml
export HELM_REPOSITORY_CACHE=/tmp/nktp-cache
pins="$(sha256sum nktp/Chart.yaml nktp/Chart.lock)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm repo add nktp-otel https://open-telemetry.github.io/opentelemetry-helm-charts
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm repo add nktp-prometheus https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm repo add nktp-metrics https://kubernetes-sigs.github.io/metrics-server/
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm dependency build nktp --skip-refresh
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -
set -- nktp/charts/*.tgz
test "$#" -eq 3
printf '%s\n' \
  '084e6edb680cf4e2acc30bd496568c53fdf663cbacf6e17876b25785c35b7a13  nktp/charts/metrics-server-3.13.1.tgz' \
  'e3460a7572a2b9c98ff421a29501dc26cdd09d83859f0556f6c3f5443793afda  nktp/charts/opentelemetry-kube-stack-0.25.1.tgz' \
  '70fab291e00a34c58fd943bb075fecc2e2e73fa95db1bcbbe7cdfe008795354a  nktp/charts/prometheus-node-exporter-4.56.1.tgz' \
  | sha256sum -c -

buildCommand:
readonly stream=2.4.2
readonly revision=1+git.8af51273d52d
readonly out=/src/nvkr-output
readonly charts="$out/charts"
readonly images="$out/images"
readonly image_dir="$images/usr/lib/nvke/cni-ovn/$stream"
readonly image_name="ovn-images_${stream}_linux_{{.Arch}}.tgz"
mkdir -p "$charts/DEBIAN" "$charts/etc/dgx/ovn-kubernetes" "$images/DEBIAN" "$image_dir" "$out/debs"
tar -xf /nvkr/inputs/materials/ovn-chart -C "$charts/etc/dgx"
test -f "$charts/etc/dgx/ovn-kubernetes/Chart.yaml"
grep -qx "version: $stream" "$charts/etc/dgx/ovn-kubernetes/Chart.yaml"
# Fork-specific keys: the old upstream global.image override does not apply.
cat >"$charts/etc/dgx/ovn-kubernetes/values-nke.yaml" <<'EOF'
global:
  skipCallToK8s: true
  imagePullSecretName: ""
  useImageDigest: false
ovnkube-control-plane:
  ovnkubeControlPlane:
    image: &built_image
      repository: localhost/nvke/ovn-kubernetes
      tag: git-8af51273d52dfa07454435d18d37230e582d797a
      sha256: ""
ovnkube-single-node-zone:
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZone:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneNbdb:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneSbdb:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneNorthd:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneOvnHost:
    image: *built_image
EOF
for kind in charts images; do
  root="$out/$kind"
  cat >"$root/DEBIAN/control" <<EOF
Package: nvke-cni-ovn-$kind-$stream
Version: $revision
Architecture: {{.Arch}}
Maintainer: NVKE <nke-dev@exchange.nvidia.com>
Provides: nvke-cni-ovn-$kind, nke-cni-ovn-$kind, nke-cni-ovn-$kind-$stream
Conflicts: nvke-cni-ovn-$kind, nke-cni-ovn-$kind
Description: NVKE OVN $kind from pinned DSX source
EOF
done
printf 'Depends: containerd | nvke-kubeadm-distro | nke-kubeadm-distro\n' >>"$images/DEBIAN/control"
gzip -n -9 -c /nvkr/inputs/materials/ovn-image >"$image_dir/$image_name"
(cd "$image_dir" && sha256sum "$image_name" >"$image_name.sha256")
# Preserve the offline containerd import contract and fail configuration
# on checksum, readiness or import errors.
cat >"$images/DEBIAN/postinst" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
set -euo pipefail
[ "${1:-}" = configure ] || exit 0
readonly image_dir=/usr/lib/nvke/cni-ovn/2.4.2
readonly image_name=ovn-images_2.4.2_linux_{{.Arch}}.tgz
if [ -n "${NKE_CTR_BIN:-}" ]; then
  ctr="$(command -v "$NKE_CTR_BIN")" || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $NKE_CTR_BIN" >&2; exit 1; }
elif [ -x /usr/local/bin/ctr ]; then
  ctr=/usr/local/bin/ctr
else
  ctr="$(command -v ctr)" || { echo 'OVN import: ctr not found' >&2; exit 1; }
fi
[ -f "$ctr" ] && [ -x "$ctr" ] || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $ctr" >&2; exit 1; }
readonly ctr
readonly log=/var/log/nvke-cni-ovn-postinst.log
cd "$image_dir"
sha256sum --strict -c "$image_name.sha256"
ready=false
for ((n=0; n<50; n++)); do
  if timeout --kill-after=1s 2s "$ctr" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=true; break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
"$ready" || { echo 'OVN import: containerd readiness timed out' >&2; exit 1; }
gzip -dc "$image_name" | timeout --kill-after=5s 300s "$ctr" -n k8s.io images import - >>"$log" 2>&1 \
  || { echo "OVN import failed; see $log" >&2; exit 1; }
EOF
chmod 0755 "$images/DEBIAN/postinst"
for kind in charts images; do
  root="$out/$kind"
  find "$root" -print0 | xargs -0 touch -h -d "@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"
  dpkg-deb --root-owner-group --uniform-compression -Zxz -z6 --build "$root" \
    "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-${kind}-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb"
done
packages=("$out/debs"/*.deb)
test "${#packages[@]}" -eq 2
test -f "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-images-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-images-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Package)" = "nvke-cni-ovn-images-$stream"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-images-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Architecture)" = "{{.Arch}}"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-images-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Provides)" = "nvke-cni-ovn-images, nke-cni-ovn-images, nke-cni-ovn-images-$stream"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-images-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Conflicts)" = "nvke-cni-ovn-images, nke-cni-ovn-images"
test -f "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-charts-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-charts-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Package)" = "nvke-cni-ovn-charts-$stream"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-charts-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Architecture)" = "{{.Arch}}"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-charts-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Provides)" = "nvke-cni-ovn-charts, nke-cni-ovn-charts, nke-cni-ovn-charts-$stream"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-charts-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Conflicts)" = "nvke-cni-ovn-charts, nke-cni-ovn-charts"
tar --format=ustar --sort=name --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --owner=0 --group=0 \
  --numeric-owner -C "$out/debs" -cf "$out/nvke-cni-ovn.tar" .

# NVIDIA publishes these DOCA OVS debs without source; the vendor stage
# verified each against NVKE's committed lock.
cd /src/os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs
packages=(*.deb)
test "${#packages[@]}" -eq 8
switch=(doca-openvswitch-switch_*_{{.Arch}}.deb)
test "${#switch[@]}" -eq 1
test -f "${switch[0]}"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "${switch[0]}" Package)" = doca-openvswitch-switch
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "${switch[0]}" Architecture)" = "{{.Arch}}"
mkdir -p /src/nvkr-output
# The composer accepts only .deb archive members.
tar --format=ustar --sort=name --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" \
  --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner \
  -cf /src/nvkr-output/nvke-doca-ovs.tar -- *.deb
vendorCommand:
test ! -e os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs
test ! -L os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs
# The source Makefile owns the DOCA version, package set and committed
# per-deb SHA-256 lock. Stage beside the checkout; protected vendors
# mount /tmp with noexec.
bundle_root="$(mktemp -d "$(dirname "$PWD")/nvkr-doca.XXXXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$bundle_root"' EXIT
timeout --kill-after=10s 540s make -C os-image/packages/doca-ovs debs \
  ARCH={{.Arch}} UBUNTU_SERIES=26.04 \
  DIST_DIR="$bundle_root/dist" OUT_DIR="$bundle_root/debs"
mkdir os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs
cp "$bundle_root/debs/"*.deb os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs/

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
set -euo pipefail
[ "${1:-}" = configure ] || exit 0
readonly image_dir=/usr/lib/nvke/cni-ovn/2.4.2
readonly image_name=ovn-images_2.4.2_linux_{{.Arch}}.tgz

  ctr="$(command -v "$NKE_CTR_BIN")" || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $NKE_CTR_BIN" >&2; exit 1; }
elif [ -x /usr/local/bin/ctr ]; then
  ctr=/usr/local/bin/ctr
else
  ctr="$(command -v ctr)" || { echo 'OVN import: ctr not found' >&2; exit 1; }

[ -f "$ctr" ] && [ -x "$ctr" ] || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $ctr" >&2; exit 1; }
readonly ctr
readonly log=/var/log/nvke-cni-ovn-postinst.log
cd "$image_dir"
sha256sum --strict -c "$image_name.sha256"
ready=false
for ((n=0; n<50; n++)); do
  if timeout --kill-after=1s 2s "$ctr" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=true; break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
"$ready" || { echo 'OVN import: containerd readiness timed out' >&2; exit 1; }

test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-charts-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Architecture)" = "{{.Arch}}"

(cd "$image_dir" && sha256sum "$image_name" >"$image_name.sha256")
# Preserve the offline containerd import contract and fail configuration
# on checksum, readiness or import errors.
cat >"$images/DEBIAN/postinst" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
set -euo pipefail
[ "${1:-}" = configure ] || exit 0
readonly image_dir=/usr/lib/nvke/cni-ovn/2.4.2
readonly image_name=ovn-images_2.4.2_linux_{{.Arch}}.tgz
if [ -n "${NKE_CTR_BIN:-}" ]; then
  ctr="$(command -v "$NKE_CTR_BIN")" || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $NKE_CTR_BIN" >&2; exit 1; }
elif [ -x /usr/local/bin/ctr ]; then
  ctr=/usr/local/bin/ctr
else
  ctr="$(command -v ctr)" || { echo 'OVN import: ctr not found' >&2; exit 1; }
fi
[ -f "$ctr" ] && [ -x "$ctr" ] || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $ctr" >&2; exit 1; }
readonly ctr
readonly log=/var/log/nvke-cni-ovn-postinst.log
cd "$image_dir"
sha256sum --strict -c "$image_name.sha256"
ready=false
for ((n=0; n<50; n++)); do
  if timeout --kill-after=1s 2s "$ctr" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=true; break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
"$ready" || { echo 'OVN import: containerd readiness timed out' >&2; exit 1; }
gzip -dc "$image_name" | timeout --kill-after=5s 300s "$ctr" -n k8s.io images import - >>"$log" 2>&1 \
  || { echo "OVN import failed; see $log" >&2; exit 1; }

global:
  skipCallToK8s: true
  imagePullSecretName: ""
  useImageDigest: false
ovnkube-control-plane:

    image: &built_image

      sha256: ""

    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneSbdb:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneNorthd:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneOvnHost:
    image: *built_image

gzip -n -9 -c /nvkr/inputs/materials/ovn-image >"$image_dir/$image_name"
(cd "$image_dir" && sha256sum "$image_name" >"$image_name.sha256")
# Preserve the offline containerd import contract and fail configuration
# on checksum, readiness or import errors.
cat >"$images/DEBIAN/postinst" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
set -euo pipefail
[ "${1:-}" = configure ] || exit 0
readonly image_dir=/usr/lib/nvke/cni-ovn/2.4.2
readonly image_name=ovn-images_2.4.2_linux_{{.Arch}}.tgz
if [ -n "${NKE_CTR_BIN:-}" ]; then
  ctr="$(command -v "$NKE_CTR_BIN")" || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $NKE_CTR_BIN" >&2; exit 1; }
elif [ -x /usr/local/bin/ctr ]; then
  ctr=/usr/local/bin/ctr
else
  ctr="$(command -v ctr)" || { echo 'OVN import: ctr not found' >&2; exit 1; }
fi
[ -f "$ctr" ] && [ -x "$ctr" ] || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $ctr" >&2; exit 1; }
readonly ctr
readonly log=/var/log/nvke-cni-ovn-postinst.log
cd "$image_dir"
sha256sum --strict -c "$image_name.sha256"
ready=false
for ((n=0; n<50; n++)); do
  if timeout --kill-after=1s 2s "$ctr" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=true; break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
"$ready" || { echo 'OVN import: containerd readiness timed out' >&2; exit 1; }
gzip -dc "$image_name" | timeout --kill-after=5s 300s "$ctr" -n k8s.io images import - >>"$log" 2>&1 \
  || { echo "OVN import failed; see $log" >&2; exit 1; }

test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$out/debs/nvke-cni-ovn-images-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb" Package)" = "nvke-cni-ovn-images-$stream"

# on checksum, readiness or import errors.

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
set -euo pipefail
[ "${1:-}" = configure ] || exit 0
readonly image_dir=/usr/lib/nvke/cni-ovn/2.4.2
readonly image_name=ovn-images_2.4.2_linux_amd64.tgz
if [ -n "${NKE_CTR_BIN:-}" ]; then
  ctr="$(command -v "$NKE_CTR_BIN")" || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $NKE_CTR_BIN" >&2; exit 1; }
elif [ -x /usr/local/bin/ctr ]; then
  ctr=/usr/local/bin/ctr
else
  ctr="$(command -v ctr)" || { echo 'OVN import: ctr not found' >&2; exit 1; }

[ -f "$ctr" ] && [ -x "$ctr" ] || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $ctr" >&2; exit 1; }
readonly ctr
readonly log=/var/log/nvke-cni-ovn-postinst.log
cd "$image_dir"
sha256sum --strict -c "$image_name.sha256"
ready=false
for ((n=0; n<50; n++)); do
  if timeout --kill-after=1s 2s "$ctr" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=true; break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
"$ready" || { echo 'OVN import: containerd readiness timed out' >&2; exit 1; }
gzip -dc "$image_name" | timeout --kill-after=5s 300s "$ctr" -n k8s.io images import - >>"$log" 2>&1 \
  || { echo "OVN import failed; see $log" >&2; exit 1; }

[Output]
Format=oci
CompressOutput=no
SplitArtifacts=
ManifestFormat=json

[Content]
Bootable=no
# Keep package-generated dates and archive mtimes fixed independently of snapshots.
SourceDateEpoch=0
WithDocs=yes
WithRecommends=no
CleanPackageMetadata=no
# These files describe the assembly attempt rather than runtime inputs.
# Keep /var/lib package state and /etc/ld.so.cache for installed-content evidence.
RemoveFiles=/var/cache/*
            /var/log/*

[Build]
BuildSources=
Incremental=no
CacheKey=nvkr-vm-runtime
ExtraSearchPaths=/inputs/nvkr-tar-v1

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

[Output]
Format=oci
CompressOutput=no
SplitArtifacts=
ManifestFormat=json

[Content]
Bootable=no
# Keep package-generated dates and archive mtimes fixed independently of snapshots.
SourceDateEpoch=0
WithDocs=yes
WithRecommends=no
CleanPackageMetadata=no
# These files describe the assembly attempt rather than runtime inputs.
# Keep /var/lib package state and /etc/ld.so.cache for installed-content evidence.
RemoveFiles=/var/cache/*
            /var/log/*

[Build]
BuildSources=
Incremental=no
CacheKey=nvkr-vm-runtime
ExtraSearchPaths=/inputs/nvkr-tar-v1

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

[Output]
Format=oci
CompressOutput=no
SplitArtifacts=
ManifestFormat=json

[Content]
Bootable=no
# Keep package-generated dates and archive mtimes fixed independently of snapshots.
SourceDateEpoch=0
WithDocs=yes
WithRecommends=no
CleanPackageMetadata=no
# These files describe the assembly attempt rather than runtime inputs.
# Keep /var/lib package state and /etc/ld.so.cache for installed-content evidence.
RemoveFiles=/var/cache/*
            /var/log/*

[Build]
BuildSources=
Incremental=no
CacheKey=nvkr-vm-runtime
ExtraSearchPaths=/inputs/nvkr-tar-v1

[Output]
Format=oci
CompressOutput=no
SplitArtifacts=
ManifestFormat=json

[Content]
Bootable=no
# Keep package-generated dates and archive mtimes fixed independently of snapshots.
SourceDateEpoch=0
WithDocs=yes
WithRecommends=no
CleanPackageMetadata=no
# These files describe the assembly attempt rather than runtime inputs.

RemoveFiles=/var/cache/*
            /var/log/*

[Build]
BuildSources=
Incremental=no
CacheKey=nvkr-vm-runtime
ExtraSearchPaths=/inputs/nvkr-tar-v1

ExtraSearchPaths=/inputs/nvkr-tar-v1

ExtraSearchPaths=/inputs/nvkr-tar-v1

export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=
test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum
pins="$(sha256sum cli/go.mod cli/go.sum controller/api/go.mod controller/api/go.sum controller/deploy/charts/go.mod management-engine/go.mod management-engine/go.sum)"
cd cli
timeout --kill-after=10s 540s go mod download

cd ..
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum --quiet -c -
test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum
